en:
Shuichi. I'm sorry I treated 
you like that.
Where's this apology coming from?

Before, I thought it was a pain 
to tell you about magic, but...

But now it's different! I've changed!
I've decided to live looking forward!

So I'm gonna tell you about magic 
without saying it's a pain.
I-I see...

<CLT=cltMIND>What is this?
She's different than usual.

Isn't...that why you came here?
To continue where we left off?

Ah, right, of course.
I'd like to hear it, if that's okay?

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps there's no real point
to this story at all.

Nyeh...I'm pleased to see you show 
so much interest in mages.

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko looked happy, but her
expression quickly faded...
I couldn't stop my master from retiring.

The person after his title got 
just what he wanted.
What? What do you mean?

One time...my master was about 
to start one of his shows...

Way in the back of the audience, my 
master's enemy was working his scheme.

Do you know about the mortal 
enemy of mages in this world?
Mortal enemy...?

They have the power to take 
away magic...an anti-mage.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is starting to sound
like a manga...

This anti-mage...took away my 
master's magic and made him fail.
What!?

My master was set up! There's no way 
he woulda failed otherwise!

My golden age master wouldn't 
lose to an anti-mage!

But the audience turned against my 
master... So I tried to wake them up.

On behalf of my master, 
I destroyed the anti-mage.

<CLT=cltMIND>So Himiko tried to fix her master's
mistakes, but that means...

My master wouldn't lose against 
someone I could defeat.
Yes, I told them off.

The show ended without any 
more problems. But...

When I went back to the green room, 
my master was gone...
I haven't seen him since then...
<CLT=cltMIND>Just as I thought...

<CLT=cltMIND>He was probably embarrassed
to have Himiko fix his mistakes.

Himiko...none of that
is your fault.
I know. I don't need your pity.
Sorry...
There's no need to apologize.

I know what my master must've 
been thinking.
He probably...disappeared for my sake.

He probably didn't want to get me 
involved in a mage power struggle...

That's right...
That musta been it.
Himiko...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Himiko's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.
<CLT=cltMIND>I couldn't find the words to say...

<CLT=cltMIND>I watched Himiko walk away, her head
hung low, and I returned to my room...
